channel_definitions.pitch: Investor pitches, partner pitches, conference talks.
channel_definitions.website_copy: Marketing site, blog posts, white papers.
channel_definitions.investor_materials: Pitch decks, financial models shown to investors, due-diligence responses.
channel_definitions.reviewer_facing: Reviewer briefings, B1 package walkthroughs, data-room Q&A.

language_class_definitions.green: Safe to use in any channel without further review. Project-internal statement that does not authorize any external claim.
language_class_definitions.yellow: Consistent with the B1 no-go list but missing required context. May be used in any channel only with the documented context. Yellow without context is a guardrail violation.
language_class_definitions.red: Prohibited in any commercial channel. Listed in the prohibited claims register.

claim_categories.rationale: Implies lender approval or acceptability to any specific lender. No lender has approved the model. B1 §1 prohibits this category.
Implies an audit / certification / accreditation. None has been issued. B1 §2 prohibits this category.
Implies a specific regulator has approved the model. No regulator has. B1 §2 prohibits this category.
Implies readiness for any specific customer or production use. None is in place. B1 §3 prohibits this category.
example_phrases: scalable (in the sense of ready for enterprise scale)

claim_categories.rationale: Generic solar is exploratory and unvalidated for any external claim. B1 §3.4 prohibits this category.
example_phrases: any solar project (in the sense of correct for any solar project)

claim_categories.rationale: Generic wind is exploratory and unvalidated for any external claim. B1 §3.4 prohibits this category.
example_phrases: any wind project (in the sense of correct for any wind project)

claim_categories.rationale: G20 is BLOCKED. B1 §6 prohibits this category.
R99 and R102 are NOT APPROVED. B1 §6 prohibits this category.
`partial_pay_sweep` and flat / min DSCR sculpting are NOT PROMOTED. B1 (general) prohibits this category.
The model is a screening tool, not an investment advisor. B1 (general) prohibits this category.
example_phrases: any statement that the user should rely on the model's output for a real decision

claim_categories.rationale: Project-internal statement of what the project is. Does not authorize any external claim.
example_phrases: Finco1 is an internal project-finance screening tool.

claim_categories.rationale: Internal validation with a real human in the loop. Pilot user is bound by an acknowledgement that forbids external-claim language.
example_phrases: We are running a controlled pilot with real human users under the B7 runbook.
claim_categories.required_context: the B7 runbook reference, on request

claim_categories.rationale: Pin covers five specific metrics per project, all under the Phase 51F guardrails. Pin is regression protection, not external validation.
example_phrases: TUHO Wind 1 and Oborovo Solar PV are reference projects with outputs pinned for regression protection.
claim_categories.required_context: the Phase 51F pin scope, on request

claim_categories.rationale: Project-internal approval for internal use, not external approval. Yellow without context is a guardrail violation.
example_phrases: The model is approved for our internal use.
claim_categories.required_context: the pilot protocol (B7) and the B3 matrix; never use without context

claim_categories.rationale: Pin covers five specific metrics per project, not generic outputs. Yellow without context implies generic correctness.
example_phrases: The model produces specific outputs for specific inputs.
claim_categories.required_context: the TUHO and Oborovo pin scope, not generic; never use without context

claim_categories.rationale: Pilot is internal validation, not a sales process. Yellow without context implies a customer relationship.
example_phrases: We are running a controlled pilot.
claim_categories.required_context: the B7 runbook, not a customer reference; never use without context

claim_categories.rationale: B8 tracker is intentionally conservative (10% enterprise_saas_readiness with null target). Yellow without context implies near-readiness.
example_phrases: We are working towards enterprise readiness.
claim_categories.required_context: the B8 tracker, 10% current, multi-year effort; never use without context

global_notes: The matrix is the per-channel / per-claim authority grid. The prohibited claims register is the source of truth for what must not be said. The approved demo language is a curated set of green statements.
All claim categories are listed for every channel; the 'color' determines whether the claim may be used in the channel and under what context.
The matrix does not authorize any external claim. It is internal governance.
Removing a red entry from the matrix requires a dedicated governance change and an explicit relaxation of the corresponding B1 no-go claim. It is not a routine operation.
